name: Mark free spots on a support
description: Show where the held object can go on a support surface: drive to a stand-off pose from which the whole surface is in one head camera frame (the pose the robot stands at is kept when it already is), aim the head at it, and number up to six spread-out free spots on that head image. Every spot fits the object at any turn with room left to its neighbours and is in view. The numbered image comes with the next observation (images entry with overlay "place_spots"); disc n is spots[n-1]. Nothing is placed: place the object with place(object, receptacle=support, hint_xy=<the chosen spot's xy>).

object.description: The right-held object the spots are for (its footprint).

support.description: The table, desk, counter or shelf surface to mark.

spots.description: Free spots [x, y] in metres; spot n is the disc numbered n on the image.

coverage.description: Fraction of the surface in the head camera frame (1 = all of it).

precheck.name: holding
precheck.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

verifier.name: in_view
verifier.meaning: Target point inside the head camera frustum, within 5 m, line of sight not blocked by furniture boxes.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

relations.when: the object goes to the chosen spot
relations.reason: one of the spots output becomes place's hint_xy

relations.when: the surface only has to be seen, not marked

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
